agencyName: Virginia Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation (DPOR), Board for Contractors
authorityRationale: DPOR's own dedicated PDF listing every real, named, rank-specific bilateral reciprocal agreement (Kentucky, Maryland, West Virginia) — the single strongest and most directly on-point source found across the entire Phase 2D electrician research pass (2D.1, 2D.2). States the exact qualifying state and license rank for each agreement explicitly, not inferred.
reliabilityRationale: A primary document whose sole purpose is listing these exact reciprocal agreements — found and used in Phase 2D.1/2D.2 specifically because of its direct, unambiguous relevance.
